q: Karnal's chemical units run mostly on coal and LDO: what is the footprint per tonne?
title: Karnal chemical units: CO2 per tonne
short: Coal decides most of it: close to 58% of the CO2. Karnal's 91 working chemical units make about 104,528 t a year from 7,007 t of coal, 1,171 kL of oil and 8.7 million kWh, roughly 21,300 t CO2 on today's factors, or about 0.2 t per tonne of product.
audience: Soap, detergent, paint, resin and pharma units in the Karnal chemical cluster

sections.h: Two very different kinds of unit
ul: Pharma and API units are about 53% of units but only 13,578 t of output. A typical one uses 6.82 toe a year, all electricity.
Other chemicals (soaps, detergents, paints, resins, surfactants) make 90,949 t. A typical one uses 114.92 toe, 88% of it thermal, on coal and diesel.
So an average for the cluster fits neither: work out your own.
107 MSMEs, about 91 operating; 4,947 toe a year.
Coal 64% of energy, oil (LDO, furnace oil, diesel) 21%, electricity 15 to 18%.
Coal of 4,200 to 4,800 kcal per kg goes mostly into boilers for process steam.

sections.h: Work out your own per tonne
ol: Coal tonnes from purchase bills, adjusted for stock, x 1.76 t CO2 (Indian coal) or 2.44 (imported).
Oil: litres x 2.645 kg for diesel or LDO, 2.97 kg for furnace oil.
Divide by tonnes dispatched in the same months.

p: Condensate recovery, flue gas loss reduction and insulation in the steam system, and screw compressors. Karnal is on BEE's first-phase ADEETIE list for chemicals, so a loan for listed technologies can carry an interest subvention.

example.title: Cluster footprint on today's factors (estimate)
lines: Oil: 1,171 kL x 2.645 = 3,097 t CO2 (higher if much of it is furnace oil)
Electricity: 8.7 million kWh x 0.675 = 5,873 t CO2
Total about 21,300 t / 104,528 t = 0.20 t CO2 per tonne
Typical pharma unit: 6.82 toe = about 79,300 kWh x 0.675 = 54 t CO2 a year
example.note: Quantities from the cluster profile. Coal at India's BUR-2 factor, oil at diesel's; your own invoices decide the real figure.

senseible: The calculators give a quick per tonne figure from your coal, oil and power; Senseible can then read the invoices behind it into monthly records.
